subject: Winter internship at Acuity Analytics | Pranav, IIT Bombay
why_line: Building credit models and bond views for real companies is the kind of quant finance I most want to learn, and I'd be grateful if this could reach your Pune credit team.
body:
Hi Acuity team,

I'm Pranav, a second-year Electrical Engineering student at IIT Bombay. My winter break runs from the last week of November to the first week of January, and I'd love to spend those six weeks learning with Acuity Analytics' credit research team in Kharadi.

A bit about me: I'm a Convener of IIT Bombay's Finance Club, I can't resist a good probability puzzle (I competed in Jane Street's Estimathon and was selected for their Game Night), and last winter I spent the same break interning with Ankur Warikoo's team at WebVeda. Alongside classes, I've been tinkering with small quant projects through the Quant and Finance Clubs.

Building credit models and bond views for real companies is the kind of quant finance I most want to learn, and I'd be grateful if this could reach your Pune credit team.

I'm happy to pitch in wherever I can be useful. My resume is attached, and I'd love to chat if this sounds like a fit.

Best,
Pranav Jaju

note: Pune head: Subhrojyoti Mandal (no email published).
